extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Skip Intro Pill row under Skin Settings, Playback, off by default. While an intro or recap your Jellyfin server has marked is playing, a Skip Intro or Skip Recap button shows bottom right with a bar that empties as it plays: OK skips to its end, Back hides it. Skip Credits Too adds the end credits, but not while the Next Episode Card is on. The markers come from the Intro Skipper or TheIntroDB plugin on the server. Switching the pill on offers to turn the Jellyfin add-on's own skip buttons off so the two do not overlap, and switching it off offers them back. Left off, playback looks as before.

extension.summary: Install and update the Functional skin
extension.description: Points Kodi at the Functional skin releases on GitHub. Install this once and Kodi keeps the skin up to date on its own.
